subject: how to remove axis tick marks

messages.author: 75db403eb2b8ba68
messages.subject: how to remove axis tick marks
parts:
Hi group,

I would like to remove the axis tick marks and tick marks labels. The chart should be used as a 'nice' front page illustration of another graph - otherwise the tickmarks ofcause would need to stay.

I have tried

theme_segments(axis.tick
grob(axis.tick
scale_x_continous(axis.tick

but nothing seams to work. I hope there is a scale solution, since I dont really understand grop. However - setting scale_x_xontinous(breaks = F) removes gridlines aswell as tick marks.

hope there is a simple solution I have overlooked.

Thx in advance

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: how to remove axis tick marks
parts:
Try this,

qplot(1:10,1:10) +
opts(axis.ticks = theme_blank(), axis.text.x = theme_blank(),
axis.text.y = theme_blank())

HTH,

baptiste
